description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named GroupsController. It manages web requests related to user groups within an administration module, including viewing, editing, and listing groups. The code interacts with services for group management, permissions, countries, and labels, and provides JSON responses for AJAX data loading.

classes.name: GroupsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller that manages administrative actions for user groups, including viewing, editing, and listing groups, with support for AJAX pagination.

methods.name: displayGroup
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a specific user group for editing based on group ID.

methods.name: displayGroups
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a list of all user groups.

methods.name: pageGroups
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to retrieve paginated list of groups in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the menu context in the model for navigation purposes.
